notes.title: Help Playtest Angkor!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Your friendly neighbourhood game developer checking in. I'm currently working on getting a demo ready for Angkor: The Holy City, and I'm going to need some play-testers to help me refine the systems and work out all the kinks!

If that sounds like something you would be interested in, [url=https://subscribepage.io/86AHe9]you can sign up here[/url].

And if you want to stay up to date on how the game is progressing, you can [url=https://twitter.com/_williamparsons]follow me on Twitter here[/url].

That's all for now, until next time,
Will

notes.title: Angkor is on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello world! Angkor: The Holy City is (finally) on Steam! 

Having this project finally see the light of day is a pretty emotional moment. It’s been a long road to get here, and I’m excited to keep working on bringing this game to completion for you all to enjoy.

If you want to stay up to date on development you can follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/_williamparsons]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKnHG9Vq2zx_LRHbziKuv5w]Youtube[/url], and if you’re keen to get stuck in to helping me play test, you can [url=https://subscribepage.io/86AHe9]join the mailing list here[/url] as well!

In the mean time, wishlist the game, and you’ll be hearing from me very soon!

Your friendly neighbourhood game developer,
Will
